semantics.catalogued: A decoded protocol declaration, not an implemented or universally supported app control.
semantics.support_function: An advertised device capability identifier; distinct from command opcode and inquiry.
semantics.ipa_class: Metadata corroboration; exact packet layouts require reviewed assembly or hardware evidence.
semantics.availability: Controls must require advertised capability, current availability, validated typed payload, and confirmed readback. Never transmit arbitrary catalogue-derived SET packets.

app_local_candidates.evidence: HPC/Swift ASC metadata; phone location/activity semantics require an independent macOS policy engine.
